The '''Child Bed''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. 

Two Child Beds appear in the Farmhouse automatically when the house is upgraded for the second time. It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|2000}}, and is also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

[[Children]] aged 56 days and up can only sleep in a Child Bed; they cannot sleep in any other type of bed. Conversely, players cannot sleep in a Child Bed.
